**Testing checklist**
**Please test the following on production:**

***1\. Referral code validation***
\- Try an invalid code (*e.g., "5" when only 1-2 NFTs exist*) — should show invalid message
\- Try a valid code (*e.g., "1" if NFT #1 exists*) — should show a valid message
\- Try no code — should show "No/Invalid referral code" message

***2\. Minting***
\- Attempt a mint with USDC — should work
\- Check dashboard — only successful mints should appear

***3\. NFT detail page***
\- View an NFT detail page — book cover should display fully
\- As an owner, the "*View Book*" button should be visible

***4\. Badges***
\- Check dashboard badges section — should show 8 badges (Legend removed). Remember badges display is responsive, so the screen size determines it

All fixes are live and ready for testing.

source_message.text:
Findings
Your ETH mint reverted (0x3af7…0855c on Base) because the on-chain swap router is set to 0x2626…e481, which isn’t the Uniswap V3 SwapRouter. The contract calls exactInputSingle there and it reverts, so every ETH mint will fail until the router is corrected on-chain.

USDC mint works;
\- token #1 exists and is owned by 0x3b55868Dd2ebA28f97b3dB55a4cB706a078154B5. Metadata and assets resolve:
\- Metadata: <https://api.projectrebuild.xyz/metadata/1>
\- Image: <https://api.projectrebuild.xyz/images/1.png>

execution.observed_behavior: On-chain inspection confirmed that the USDC mint created token #1, assigned it to the wallet, and produced resolving metadata and assets.
